text.tspan: CloudFront vs S3 Cross-Region Replication: both give low latency, in different ways
• Files are cached for a TTL (maybe a day):
users may see an old copy until it expires
• Great for STATIC content that must be
• Must be set up for EACH Region you want
• Files are updated in near real time
• Great for DYNAMIC content that needs low
• Everywhere + static + OK to be a bit stale → CloudFront.
• A few Regions + must be fresh (near real time) → CRR (plus apps in those Regions).
• They combine well: CloudFront in front of a bucket that is itself replicated (origin failover with an origin group).
